objects.name: Damaged Painting
objects.description: An old painting in an oilcloth case, from a wreck.

objects.name: Damaged Painting
objects.description: An old painting from the mining town, found among the crates.

objects.name: Damaged Painting
objects.description: A Dwarvish painting, warm from the volcano.

objects.name: Small Canvas
objects.description: A stretched canvas, 20 cells square. Paint on it at an easel.

objects.name: Medium Canvas
objects.description: A stretched canvas, 28 cells square: room for two things side by side.

objects.name: Large Canvas
objects.description: A stretched canvas, 36 cells square: room for a whole arrangement.

objects.name: Linen Canvas (Medium)
objects.description: Fine linen, stretched and primed. Paints like any canvas, but only on linen can a painting become a Masterpiece.

objects.name: Linen Canvas (Large)
objects.description: Fine linen, stretched and primed. Paints like any canvas, but only on linen can a painting become a Masterpiece.

objects.name: Sable Round Brush
objects.description: A soft round brush that makes mixing more forgiving.

objects.name: Flat Wash Brush
objects.description: A wide, flat brush. Each mix covers far more of the canvas.

objects.name: Rigger Brush
objects.description: A long, fine brush. Hues hold steadier, and inspiration lingers.

objects.name: Iridium Brush
objects.description: A brush that seems to know where the paint should go.

objects.name: Picture Frame
objects.description: Frame one of your paintings at an easel to hang it on a wall.

objects.name: Moonlit Frame
objects.description: A picture frame in midnight blue and silver, with a moon at the top. Sable sells them at the Night Market. Frame a painting in it at an easel.

objects.name: Gold-Leaf Frame
objects.description: A picture frame finished in gold leaf, from Sable, for a finished portfolio. Frame a painting in it at an easel.

objects.name: Driftwood Frame
objects.description: A picture frame of grey, sea-worn wood, from the museum, for the Wreck's paintings. Frame a painting in it at an easel.

objects.name: Iron Frame
objects.description: A picture frame of riveted iron, from the museum, for the Miners' paintings. Frame a painting in it at an easel.

objects.name: Sandstone Frame
objects.description: A picture frame of carved sandstone, from the museum, for Calico's paintings. Frame a painting in it at an easel.

objects.name: Dwarvish Frame
objects.description: A Dwarvish picture frame of bronze set with a gem, from the museum. Frame a painting in it at an easel.

objects.name: Pine Frame
objects.description: A plain frame in pale pine. Framed paintings hung in a room help paintings made there; pine saves a little paint.

objects.name: Oak Frame
objects.description: A sturdy oak frame. Hung in a room, it helps paintings made there teach you a little more.

objects.name: Birch Frame
objects.description: A pale birch frame, flecked with bark. Hung in a room, it brings inspiration a little sooner.

objects.name: White Frame
objects.description: A frame painted white, like a gallery's. Hung in a room, it gives paintings made there a little more light.

objects.name: Walnut Frame
objects.description: Dark walnut with brass at the corners. Hung in a room, paintings made there teach you more.

objects.name: Red Lacquer Frame
objects.description: Deep red lacquer and gold. Hung in a room, paintings made there are worth more.

objects.name: Rope Frame
objects.description: A frame wrapped in twisted rope, like a ship's. Hung in a room, it saves paint at the easel.

objects.name: Prismatic Frame
objects.description: Every colour at once. Hung in a room, inspiration comes much sooner.

objects.name: Qi's Frame
objects.description: Purple and gold, with Qi's diamond. Hung in a room, paintings made there are worth much more.

objects.name: Wooden Palette
objects.description: Holds 3 tubes' worth of each colour. Tubes you pick up go straight in. Keep it in your bag to paint; set it down and it stores paint like a chest.

objects.name: Enamel Palette

objects.name: Iridium Palette

objects.name: Varnish
objects.description: A tin of amber varnish. Put a painting in a Varnishing Cabinet with one, and it cures to a finish that's worth more.

objects.name: Old Catalogue
objects.description: The catalogue from a small gallery show in Zuzu City, ten years ago. There's a note in pencil in one margin. Julian asked you to give it to Sable.

objects.name: Margot's Loupe
objects.description: Margot's jeweller's loupe, worn on a cord. Old paintings turn up more often while you wear it.

bigCraftables.name: Easel
bigCraftables.description: Paint still lifes of anything you carry. Bring a canvas.

bigCraftables.name: Master's Easel
bigCraftables.description: An easel finished in gold leaf, for a master. Paintings made at it get a little more light.

bigCraftables.name: Pigment Mill
bigCraftables.description: Grinds clay, flowers, berries, minerals and gems into tubes of paint overnight.

bigCraftables.name: Framer's Bench
bigCraftables.description: Takes a framed painting out of its frame overnight: the painting as it was, and the empty frame to use again.

bigCraftables.name: Varnishing Cabinet
bigCraftables.description: Cures a varnished painting over weeks: satin after 7 days, gloss after 14, a gallery finish after 28. Hit it with a tool to take a painting out early.
